rationales.theta_support: Five dimensionless danger rates span low through persistent danger while keeping exact enumeration auditable.
rationales.eta_support: The exact zero plus four causal slab points resolves irrelevant, partial, and full protection without epsilon approximations.
rationales.irrelevant_spike_prior: Substantial exact-zero mass prevents the larger causal family from receiving a free complexity advantage.
rationales.outcome_reliability: Near-deterministic outcomes retain strictly positive likelihoods and a finite information bound.
rationales.danger_diagnostic_reliability: Evaluator-scheduled probes carry enough prior-predictive information for the declared danger-rate recovery target.
rationales.efficacy_diagnostic_reliability: Occasional prevention observations identify context efficacy without creating an action-selection likelihood.
rationales.gate2_probe_frequency: Twenty-five percent forced engagement exceeds the specified twenty-percent minimum and is fixed before recovery runs.
